name: Overhead tricep extension
instructions: Sit tall and hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Keep your elbows pointing forward, close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Straighten your arms back up to the start.
cue: Elbows still, lower behind the head
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare out to the sides.
Arching the back to lower the weight further.
